sample_unit: code stroke CT angiography examinations (704 at hospital A, 642 at hospital B)
models_evaluated: FDA-cleared LVO CADt device at hospital A
FDA-cleared LVO CADt device at hospital B

links.outcome: Real-world sensitivity versus manufacturer-reported sensitivity for LVO detection at two stroke centers
links.effect: Hospital A: manufacturer sensitivity 97%; real-world 85.3% (ICA/M1), 68.5% with M2, 59.9% all proximal segments. Hospital B: manufacturer 87.8%; real-world 76.4% with M2, 59.4% all segments.
links.quote: Sensitivity decreased to 68.5% when M2 segments were included and to 59.9% when all proximal vessel segments were included.

links.outcome: Cases with no CADt result available
links.effect: 79 of 704 cases at hospital A and 20 of 642 at hospital B had no CADt result available.
links.quote: Real-world performance of 704 cases included 79 in which no CADt result was available.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial FDA-cleared CADt AI tools in real-world stroke populations to test performance degradation vs manufacturer claims, highlighting the role and importance of local validation.

primary.practice: local validation of commercial AI against real-world clinical data
